# Lower-third that slides in

- Kind: `recipe`
- Category: `vector`
- Slug: `vector/lower-third-slide-in`

## Summary

Motion recipe (basic). A designed lower-third has an accent bar that wipes in first, then the text slides in about 20 px with an ease-out over 0.4 s, holds, and leaves faster than it arrived.

## Details

### When to use
An animated name or caption bar to export as video overlay, Lottie or SVG.
### What a pro does and why
A designed lower-third has an accent bar that wipes in first, then the text slides in about 20 px with an ease-out over 0.4 s, holds, and leaves faster than it arrived. The template builds the bar, two text lines and the keyframes in the lower 30 % of the canvas.
### Ops
```json
{
  "summary": "Lower-third slide-in",
  "ops": [
    {"op": "template", "kind": "lowerThird", "text": ["Alex Morgan", "Producer"], "colors": ["#ff5a36", "#ffffff"], "at": 0}
  ]
}
```
The `template` op builds the layers and keyframes in one step (MM110 `lib/vector/templates.ts`); its options are kind, text, colors, at and duration.
### How to adjust
Slower: `duration` 6000 so the motion has room. Different brand colour: change `colors[0]`. Left edge too tight: move the group with `animate` on `transform.x`.
